phrase: I can't burp, and I never could
notes: The main sign of R-CPD, and it is usually lifelong.

phrase: I've been like this since I was a kid
notes: Most people say it began before age 25, or as long as they can remember.

phrase: my parents couldn't burp me as a baby
notes: Parents often remember a baby who would not burp.

phrase: a bubble stuck in my chest
notes: Pressure behind the breastbone that a burp would relieve, but the burp never comes.

phrase: my belly swells up after eating or drinking
notes: In R-CPD the swelling is air and almost everyone has it. In achalasia the fullness comes with food sticking or coming back up.
evidence: Chen 2024 PMID 38115814; Guts UK achalasia factsheet

phrase: feeling full after a few bites
notes: In achalasia food piles up above the stomach. In R-CPD trapped air fills the belly.
evidence: Guts UK achalasia factsheet; Chen 2026 PMID 41977029

phrase: so much gas, I pass wind all the time
notes: Air that cannot come up goes down instead.

phrase: I can't throw up, even when I'm sick
notes: The same muscle that blocks burps can block vomiting.

phrase: hiccups that really hurt
notes: A newer described symptom that most survey respondents report.

phrase: fizzy drinks and beer make it much worse
notes: Carbonation adds gas that has no way out.

phrase: it gets worse on planes
notes: Trapped gas expands as the plane climbs.

phrase: I make myself gag to let air out
notes: Sometimes called air vomiting. It brings short relief.

phrase: gurgling or croaking from my throat and chest
notes: R-CPD noises come after eating or drinking, with trapped air and no burp. Zenker's gurgling comes from the neck as you swallow.

phrase: squeaky sounds when I try to burp
notes: Felt low in the neck and the top of the chest.

phrase: a gurgling bulge in my neck
notes: Only with large pouches.

phrase: food sticks at the bottom of my throat
notes: Both are felt around the Adam's apple. Zenker's also brings gurgling, bad breath and food coming back up.

phrase: pills get caught in my throat
notes: Often the first sign that the upper sphincter is not opening fully.
evidence: Laryngopedia A-CPD page; Laryngopedia Zenker's page

phrase: solid food sticks but drinks go down fine
notes: Points to the upper sphincter. In achalasia and spasm, drinks struggle too.
evidence: Laryngopedia food lodgment page; Laryngopedia A-CPD page

phrase: I have to swallow two or three times per bite
notes: With Zenker's some food or saliva also comes back up and has to be swallowed again.

phrase: my throat feels tight when I swallow
notes: Felt in the neck, and only while swallowing.

phrase: a lump in my throat
notes: If it is there all day and food goes down fine, it is often globus, which is none of these five. Still worth asking about.

phrase: I've switched to soft food because meat and bread are hard
notes: Usually worsens slowly over months to years.

phrase: food feels stuck in my chest after I eat
notes: In achalasia it happens every meal and slowly gets worse. With spasm it comes and goes, often with chest pain.

phrase: even water is hard to swallow
notes: Difficulty swallowing liquids can involve the throat or food pipe. This phrase cannot locate the problem; ask a clinician to assess it.

phrase: I drink water with every bite to push food down
notes: A common way people with achalasia get food through.

phrase: I raise my arms or arch my back to get food down
notes: Positions that help gravity push food through a closed lower sphincter.

phrase: it has slowly got worse over a couple of years
notes: Achalasia is felt in the chest and affects food and drink. A-CPD is felt in the neck and affects solids first.

phrase: coughing or choking while I eat
notes: With A-CPD or Zenker's it happens during the swallow. With achalasia it is more often after meals or when lying down.
evidence: Mari 2025 PMID 40543044; Martinez-Paredes 2022 PMID 35846818; Patel 2015 PMID 26198208

phrase: I avoid some foods because I'm scared I'll choke
notes: Fear of choking is common with problems at the top of the esophagus.

phrase: food comes back up hours later, undigested
notes: In Zenker's it comes into the mouth from a pouch in the neck, with gurgling and bad breath. In achalasia it comes from the chest, often with saliva and at night.

phrase: what comes up tastes like food, not acid
notes: Bland, undigested food points away from ordinary reflux.

phrase: I wake up with food or spit on my pillow
notes: Night-time regurgitation is a main achalasia symptom. Zenker's can also bring saliva and food up at night.

phrase: I drool or spit up a lot of saliva
notes: Saliva cannot get past the bottom of the esophagus.

phrase: losing weight without trying
notes: Both make eating hard enough that people eat less.

phrase: bad breath no matter how much I brush
notes: Food trapped in the pouch goes bad.

phrase: my voice has gone hoarse
notes: Hoarseness is more common with small pouches.

phrase: clearing my throat all the time
notes: Saliva keeps coming back up from the pouch.

phrase: coughing at night when I lie down
notes: In both, leftover food can spill toward the windpipe.

phrase: chest infections that keep coming back
notes: From food going down the windpipe, often at night.

phrase: squeezing pain behind my breastbone
notes: Spasm pain comes in episodes. Achalasia pain comes with food sticking or coming back up. R-CPD pain comes after eating, with bloating and no burp.
evidence: Patel 2022 PMID 35227779; Vaezi 2020 PMID 32773454; Lechien 2025 PMID 40411338

phrase: chest pain I thought was a heart attack
notes: Always have the heart checked first. Doctors call it non-cardiac chest pain once the heart is cleared.

phrase: my heart tests were normal but the chest pain keeps coming back
notes: Spasm is tied to swallowing. R-CPD pain is tied to trapped air after meals.

phrase: chest pain that comes and goes, even between meals
notes: Spasm comes in episodes. Achalasia pain can come before or after eating.

phrase: very hot or very cold drinks set it off
notes: A known trigger for spasm.

phrase: something caught in my throat or chest that comes and goes
notes: The problem is low in the esophagus but can be felt as high as the throat.

phrase: heartburn
notes: Heartburn on its own is usually reflux. It is worth asking about these when it comes with food sticking, undigested food coming back up, or not being able to burp.

phrase: acid reflux pills don't help
notes: When acid medicine fails, guidelines say to test for a swallowing-muscle problem.

phrase: the doctor said it was just reflux
notes: Achalasia is most often first misdiagnosed as reflux. About a third of R-CPD survey respondents were told it was reflux.

phrase: I was told it was trapped wind or IBS
notes: Bloating and throat noises often get blamed on the gut first.

phrase: I was told it was anxiety or an eating disorder
notes: Bringing up undigested food without trying can be mistaken for making yourself sick, especially in young people.
